productOverview.headline: Your Daily Driver for Rapid Survey Deployment
productOverview.description: The DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise is a highly portable RTK-enabled mapping drone built for rapid deployment, land subdivision, cadastral overlays, and site progress monitoring.

keyFeatures.headline: Key Features
keyFeatures.description: What makes the Mavic 3 Enterprise the go-to daily survey drone.

items.title: 4/3 CMOS Camera
items.description: 20 MP resolution with a mechanical shutter, critical for accurate mapping.

items.title: Optional RTK Module
items.description: Delivers ±2-3 cm horizontal and ±3-5 cm vertical accuracy when fitted.

items.title: Rapid Deployment
items.description: Ready to fly in under 2 minutes, fits in a compact field kit.

items.title: Efficient Coverage
items.description: ~43 minutes flight time covering up to 200 hectares per day.

cameraSystem.headline: Camera System
cameraSystem.description: Purpose-built optics for accurate photogrammetric capture.
